scripts.wasm: cargo build -p riftline-sim --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir client/src/wasm target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/riftline_sim.wasm
scripts.dev: npm run wasm && (cargo run -p riftline-server & npm run dev -w client)
scripts.build: npm run wasm && npm run build -w client && cargo build --release -p riftline-server
